title: Warm Burst Tomato Rocket and Mozzarella
ingredients: 250g (9oz) red and yellow cherry tomatoes, halved
125g (4.5oz) mozzarella pearls, or mozzarella torn into small pieces
method: Preheat the oven to 240°C/220°C fan (475°F), Gas Mark 9.
In a medium-sized bowl, mix together the tomatoes, garlic and olive oil, then spread into a single layer on a baking tray. Season with salt and pepper.
Roast the tomatoes for 20 minutes. Remove from the oven and allow to cool slightly.
Toss the tomatoes in a serving bowl with the rocket and mozzarella, drizzle over the balsamic vinegar, then finish with torn basil leaves and a small grinding of coarse sea salt.
notes: Add 1 tablespoon of Crunchy Seed Sprinkle (p.218) for extra crunch. Bulk up with a pre-cooked grain mix such as quinoa and bulgur wheat.
